name: Arctic Lights Comic Con
blurb: Helsinki's pop-culture convention at the Expo and Convention Centre, with international voice-acting, comic-art and author guests and an artist alley.

editions.evidence: Homepage text: '3.–4.4 2027, Helsinki Expo and Convention Centre'

notes: Star Guests page lists people under 'Special Guests', 'Influencers' and 'International Comic Artists, Authors and Editors' headings; two extracted tiles (#5 and #6 in the candidate file) are decorative section art (a recycled 'tahtivieraat'/star-guests graphic and the '2027 Influencers' heading image) with no named person, and were excluded. No bio text appears on any guest card, so 'Known for' is left blank throughout, even for guests independently known to this agent (Rich Keeble and Kirsty Rider voice Clair Obscur: Expedition 33; Matt Dinniman writes Dungeon Crawler Carl) — only their cat values reflect that outside knowledge, applied conservatively; Richard Price's specialty could not be determined and is filed as 'other'. The homepage's og image filename is tagged 'ALCC26' (last year's key art) but is still the page's current meta image; no fresher wide banner was found this session. Verify-03 pass (2026-10-05): confirmed current, more strongly than first recorded -- a fresh re-extraction shows the guest page's own section headings reading '2027 Special Guests', '2027 Influencers' and '2027 International Comic Artists, Authors and Editors', directly naming this edition (the ALCC26 cover-image caveat above is unrelated to the guest list itself). REFUTE-pass (2026-10-05): upheld, all 12 proven -- re-extraction reconfirms the same '2027 Special Guests'/'2027 International Comic Artists, Authors and Editors' card-label headings; dug further into the 3 'Special Guests' photo filenames (Richard Price, Rich Keeble, Kirsty Rider), which oddly carry an 'ALCC26' tag despite sitting under the '2027' heading, but neither name appears in Messukeskus's own May 2026 press release or in RosterCon's listing for Arctic Lights Comic Con 2026 (whose actual lineup was Christopher Eccleston, Jamie Campbell Bower, Pom Klementieff, Amanda Conner etc.), so they are not recycled 2026 guests -- the 'ALCC26' tag is an inconsistent internal filename label, not evidence of staleness.
